title: Desk Guide: Discount Horizon of Pass-Through Rows Elected for Early Retirement (Capital Credits)
content:
# Discount Horizon of Pass-Through Rows Elected for Early Retirement

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** For a wholesale-supplier pass-through row elected by a former member under an approved discounted early retirement, the pass-through discount horizon is counted by the row's whole years from rotation on its expected rotation:

- a row at least **10** whole years away is discounted over those whole years less the full calendar months already elapsed in the year of the election, taken in twelfths of a year;
- a row no more than **2** whole years away is not discounted at all (paid at full value);
- any other row is discounted over its whole years.

## Input – judgement – output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| whole years from rotation: 10 or more | long horizon | whole years less the elapsed months in twelfths |
| whole years from rotation: 3 to 9 | middle horizon | the whole years |
| whole years from rotation: 0, 1 or 2 | near rotation | no discount |

**Whole years from rotation** are the whole calendar years from the year of the election to the year the row would be retired in the general rotation on its expected rotation, never fewer than zero.

**Full calendar months already elapsed in the year of the election** are the whole months from January 1 of that year up to the date of the election.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Election date | Months elapsed | Whole years from rotation | Horizon |
|---|---|---|---|
| a day in May | 4 | 15 | 14 and two thirds of a year (15 less 4 twelfths) |
| a day in May | 4 | 10 | 9 and two thirds of a year |
| a day in May | 4 | 6 | 6 years |
| a day in May | 4 | 2 | none — full value |
| a day in January | 0 | 15 | 15 years |
